description: A workflow canvas (n8n / node-editor style) on a dot grid that moves with the camera: nodes are cards with an icon, a title, a mono tag, body lines (`code` chips, **accent** words), optional chains of sub-step chips and an optional media panel that plays when the node lights (waveform, typed code / YAML, a frame timeline with a playhead and a real frame counter, parallel progress lanes, an image strip, a small motion preview); `kind: hub` = an orchestrator with a turning glow rim, `kind: gate` = a human approval step (amber, dashed while it waits, "approved" when it lights). Nodes draw in dim, then light up at `at` with a glow flash and a check badge while a glowing pulse runs down each wire (bezier or rounded elbow, optionally dashed) and fills it; finished wires keep calm travelling capsules, and `again` sends extra bright pulses (e.g. one pulse tracing the whole path at the end); camera keys pan and zoom across the canvas (log-space zoom). `hero` = a simple big version of the flow shown first (a moving cover: lit cards, pulses running), then at `hero.at` every hero card flies to and turns into its node(s) in the full graph (one card can split open into several) while the remaining nodes pop in around them. Coordinates are canvas units (`canvas: {w, h}`, zoom 1 = the whole canvas fits).
